assets.name: hero-frame
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated reusable raster game UI master. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not a layout to reproduce. Match its fine dark engraved linework, worn enamel, gold/ivory/plum palette and surreal Victorian fight-cabinet craft, simplified for readable game menus. A single rectangular menu FRAME, landscape ratio 4:3, transparent open center and transparent outside. Restrained gold and aged ivory carved corners, very thin straight gold rails along four edges, tiny watchful eye crest centered top, small booklike lower corners. No towers, curtains, boxing gloves or large protrusions. Center must be completely empty transparent. Frame occupies most canvas with a safe clear margin; straight edge middles intended for nine-slice scaling. Orthographic front view, no perspective, no scene, no lettering, no labels, no symbols resembling text, no logo, no mockup. True transparent alpha background. One asset only.
